## Description

Hydraulic oil filter for the Caterpillar 308C2 excavator, OE SH66279 / 362-1163. The source confirms the Cat references and the excavator application but dimensions, media and efficiency are reference values only. Hydraulic selection turns on system pressure, flow rate and the circuit cleanliness target, so those inputs decide the element. Buyers should supply flow and pressure and state the ISO 4406 target, then request pressure-drop and beta-ratio data.
